# Hollingate Gasworks - plant office

Strength tests on new mains are recorded from the gauge in kilopascals.
The site log the works keeps its pressures in is written in bar.

turns.prompt: Hollingate Gasworks is closing out the strength test on the new booster main. The gauge held 2,750 kilopascals, and the site log is kept in bar at one hundred kilopascals to the bar. What figure in bar goes into the site log?
